grocery_and_food_retail.name: Kroger
grocery_and_food_retail.description: Full-service grocery chain. Primary grocery stop for most Bellefontaine households.
grocery_and_food_retail.flavor_text: The deli line on Sunday morning stretches past the greeting cards. The bakery's fried chicken is a local secret.

grocery_and_food_retail.name: Walmart Supercenter — Grocery Section
grocery_and_food_retail.description: One-stop shop. Cheapest grocery option in town. The go-to for bulk purchases.
grocery_and_food_retail.flavor_text: At 2 AM the only people in Walmart are nurses just off shift and a guy buying twenty cases of Mountain Dew.

grocery_and_food_retail.name: ALDI
grocery_and_food_retail.description: German discount chain. No-frills, cheap, efficient. Devoted regulars.
grocery_and_food_retail.flavor_text: You bring your own bags or pay for them. The checkout line moves fast and they mean it.

grocery_and_food_retail.name: Dollar General — S. Main
grocery_and_food_retail.description: Dollar General locations throughout the county. Fill-in grocery and household staples.
grocery_and_food_retail.flavor_text: There are at least four of these within ten miles. They all smell the same.

grocery_and_food_retail.name: Logan County Locker — Meat Processing
grocery_and_food_retail.description: Local meat processor. Deer season is their Super Bowl. Farmers bring whole animals.
grocery_and_food_retail.flavor_text: Come November the parking lot is full of trucks with deer in the bed. The owner knows every farm family in the county.

restaurants.name: Roosters Wing Shack
restaurants.flavor_text: Packed every Sunday after church and every Friday night in football season. The bar fills up for Ohio State games.

restaurants.name: Bob Evans
restaurants.flavor_text: The senior coffee crowd claims their tables by 7 AM. Don't try to take table six — Earl's been sitting there since 2009.

restaurants.name: McDonald's
restaurants.flavor_text: The drive-thru wraps around the building on Friday mornings. The ice cream machine has a reputation.

restaurants.name: Wendy's
restaurants.flavor_text: The lunch crowd from the county offices hits this every day at noon sharp.

restaurants.name: Taco Bell
restaurants.flavor_text: The late-night drive-thru line at 1:30 AM on weekends is a social scene in itself.

restaurants.name: Subway
restaurants.flavor_text: The lunchtime rush from Mary Rutan nurses is the peak hour.

restaurants.name: Pizza Hut
restaurants.flavor_text: Delivery radius covers most of the city. Friday night is their biggest night by a mile.

restaurants.name: Domino's Pizza
restaurants.flavor_text: The tracker shows your order moving in real time. Three people in town drive for Domino's as their second job.

restaurants.name: China Buffet
restaurants.flavor_text: Birthday celebrations, after-church lunches, kids' first exposure to chopsticks. A beloved institution.

restaurants.name: Casa Garcia's Mexican Restaurant
restaurants.flavor_text: The margaritas are strong and the portions are generous. Friday nights have a wait.

restaurants.name: Downtown Diner (Local)
restaurants.flavor_text: The counter stools fill up at 6:15 AM. Farmers, retirees, city workers — everyone knows everyone. Coffee is bottomless.

restaurants.name: Tony's Pizzeria (Local)
restaurants.flavor_text: Third-generation recipe. The owners know every name in town. Fridays in fall they're swamped after the football game.

bars_and_nightlife.name: Bellefontaine Elks Lodge #402
bars_and_nightlife.flavor_text: If you've been in Bellefontaine long enough, someone sponsored your membership. The fish fry on Fridays is a Lent institution.

bars_and_nightlife.name: Ham's Bar & Grill
bars_and_nightlife.atmosphere: laid-back neighborhood bar, pool table, darts
bars_and_nightlife.flavor_text: The pool table is first-come-first-served and people take it seriously. Karaoke Thursdays have a cult following.

bars_and_nightlife.name: Bellefontaine VFW Post 1038
bars_and_nightlife.flavor_text: The cheapest cold beer in the county if you're a member. The guys at the end of the bar have stories you need to earn the right to hear.

bars_and_nightlife.name: American Legion Post 243
bars_and_nightlife.flavor_text: The Legion runs the best bingo in the county and everyone in town has been to at least one fish fry here.

bars_and_nightlife.name: The Tap House Bellefontaine
bars_and_nightlife.atmosphere: younger crowd, craft beer focus, TVs for sports
bars_and_nightlife.flavor_text: The craft beer crowd found each other here. Trivia Wednesdays fill every table by 7 PM.

shopping_and_retail.name: Walmart Supercenter
shopping_and_retail.flavor_text: The everything store. Everything available within 10 minutes of your house.

shopping_and_retail.name: Dollar Tree
shopping_and_retail.flavor_text: Birthday parties, Halloween, Easter — the Dollar Tree seasonally transforms.

shopping_and_retail.name: Family Dollar
shopping_and_retail.flavor_text: South side anchor. More grocery inventory than Dollar Tree.

shopping_and_retail.name: Tractor Supply Co.
shopping_and_retail.flavor_text: Chick Days in spring draws half the township. If you need it for a farm, they have it.

shopping_and_retail.name: AutoZone
shopping_and_retail.flavor_text: Half the county changes their own oil. The free OBD-II scanner service is used constantly.

shopping_and_retail.name: Advance Auto Parts
shopping_and_retail.flavor_text: Competes with AutoZone two miles away. Locals have strong preferences for one or the other.

shopping_and_retail.name: Cato Fashions
shopping_and_retail.flavor_text: Budget fashion anchor. Prom alternatives, church clothes, work basics.

shopping_and_retail.name: Ace Hardware — Bellefontaine
shopping_and_retail.flavor_text: The staff actually knows what every part is for. A different universe from the big-box hardware stores.

shopping_and_retail.name: Bellefontaine Pharmacy (Independent)
shopping_and_retail.flavor_text: The pharmacist knows your prescriptions, your family history, and your kids' names. Cannot be replaced by a chain.

shopping_and_retail.name: Goodwill — Bellefontaine
shopping_and_retail.flavor_text: The thrift store ecosystem: the serious resellers hit it Monday morning when new donations drop.

shopping_and_retail.name: 84 Lumber — Nearby / Rural King
shopping_and_retail.flavor_text: Where contractors come at 6 AM. Residential builds, farm outbuildings, deck projects.

services.name: Logan County YMCA
services.flavor_text: The pool is the crown jewel. Summer swim lessons are booked months in advance.

services.name: Logan County District Library
services.flavor_text: More activity than you'd expect. The study room has regulars who treat it like an office.

services.name: Wash & Dry Laundromat
services.flavor_text: A cross-section of humanity on Saturday mornings. Bring quarters and something to read.

services.name: Great Clips
services.flavor_text: No-appointment, no-judgment haircuts. The check-in app is either the best or worst invention.

services.name: Marathon Gas Station
services.flavor_text: The Marathon on S Main is the late-night gathering point for a certain crowd. Everyone stops here eventually.

services.name: UPS Store / Shipping Services
services.flavor_text: The eBay and Etsy sellers of Logan County know this place well.

services.name: Bellefontaine Post Office
services.flavor_text: The passport line before spring break is a reliable chaos event.

regional_shopping_notes.amazon_delivery: Standard 1-2 day Amazon delivery available. Rural addresses may experience 1-day delays.
regional_shopping_notes.market_character: Bellefontaine retail skews practical and budget-conscious. Fine dining and specialty shopping require a 30-60 minute drive to Columbus or Lima.
